items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Partner, the money is flying. You believe it.

ctx.x: anyway at night those guys would get off early. We didn't go to work till 11:00 and we stayed open till 7:00 in the morning, anyway, our club was a little small place and after 3:00 in the morning you couldn't get a seat. They'd stand around and it got so popular, we were packed and jammed. Paul Whiteman would bring all his friends and band down there. But it was so small, a lot of times the guys would want to sit in and play with the band, but they had to sit on the floor. The floor was so crowded you couldn't…
The Club Kentucky was something and the money flying. Money is flying. Partner, the money is flying. You believe it. Now that's the 20's when a dollar was a dollar. Ain't nothing now.
We had all the gangsters, all the big gangsters you read about. Some -- he got killed.
